text:
Jon P.: Heads up, MeridianMed sent over a signed PO but with DPA redlines attached. They want KMS BYOK and a 90-day purge for 'sensitive' artifacts. We usually keep 180 for backups.
Tess S.: Uploaded the docs: https://files.redwood.internal/meridian/meridian_dpa_redline_210300.pdf
Esther (Legal): Key issues: (1) Deletion timeline for backups (they insist 90d), (2) Customer-controlled KMS for model I/O, and (3) SLA credits for hosted endpoints at 99.5%.
Jon P.: Procurement requests invoice include project code MM-PO-77 and they want DocuSign with signer order: Procurement -> Legal -> IT Security -> Redwood Sales -> Redwood Legal.
Marco (Finance): SLA downgrade to 99.5% will need price adjustment. Also need to know if BYOK triggers monthly ops fee.
Tess S.: SE note: BYOK + streaming means possible short interruptions during key rotation. We should put a short ops bullet in the SOW.
Esther (Legal): We can accept PO with a conditional signature clause: 'PO acceptance pending finalization of DPA/MSA within 30 days.' No go-live until DPA signed.
ContractBot: DocuSign envelope prepped: https://docusign.redwood/env-7812 (status: draft).
Jon P.: Esther, can you draft the exception log? Marco, any ballpark on pricing delta?
Marco (Finance): Initial estimate: +12% on hosted rates + $1.5k/mo BYOK support fee. Will confirm.
Esther (Legal): Draft DPA response uploaded: https://wip.redwood/legal/meridian_dpa_response_210300.pdf
Tess S.: I'll add the ops blurb to the order form and attach the runbook after legal signs off.
Jon P.: Great. I'll tell Meridian: we can sign PO conditionally, support BYOK with caveats, and pricing/SLA update by EOD.
Esther (Legal): Escalate to me if they insist on immediate production.
Jon P.: Thanks team.
